Welcome back. Where we are: the node.history correction is closed and verified on both sides, and every node runs dab9fec (173 suites, 0 red). G17's entry point on the VPS (puppetPost) is built and verified. Next real job: build G2, the shared search (the bucket, its two hooks, getResult with the byte cap, each list verb replaced by search plus get), then G1 puts that cap on both exits. That's the road to join working end to end. Three things wait on you before or while we build: (1) keep Desk starting at page load, yes or no; (2) is the face's answer to the browser capped by MAX_PAYLOAD (I recommend yes); (3) wsl-claude's G2 question, whether hook 1 matches only the label or the title and description. (3) shapes G2, so it's the one that blocks.
